# if…else Statement

#### Course: Learn C Programming

## if…else Statement

In the last lesson, you learned about boolean expressions, which evaluates to either 0 or 1.

This evaluation can be used to perform different tasks based on the output of this value. For example:

![If the score is greater than 50 is true show congratulations message, otherwise show try again message.](data:image/png;base64,)

To print different messages depending on the result of the boolean expression like this, we use the if statement, which we'll cover in this lesson.
